title: SalesOS Therapist Meeting Kit — Phase 1

steps.name: Product home and mission pack finalized
steps.acceptance: Founder packet and product home approved; open decisions surfaced.

steps.name: DB migration for SalesOS practice tables
steps.acceptance: Creates salesos_practice_profiles, salesos_meeting_kits, salesos_call_sessions with user_id and practice URL.

steps.name: Practice research pipeline
steps.acceptance: Given a URL, returns structured research using web-search-service and site-builder-opportunity-scorer, with all fields labeled KNOW/THINK/GUESS.

steps.name: Meeting kit generator
steps.acceptance: Returns a one-screen meeting kit with the 16 fields listed in PRODUCT_HOME.md.

steps.name: Founder Brief generator
steps.acceptance: Given a meeting kit and meeting date, returns a one-page brief with who, what to ask, what to avoid, close.

steps.name: CRM integration
steps.acceptance: Read/write practice records, status, next action; reuse outreach-crm contact table.

steps.name: Call script generator
steps.acceptance: Returns a bullet-point script with opening hooks, likely objections, value prop, and meeting ask.

steps.name: Follow-up email/text templates
steps.acceptance: Generates one email and one SMS per chosen lead magnet; manual send only.

steps.name: Routes and founder UI wiring
steps.acceptance: Expose POST /api/v1/salesos/research, GET/POST /api/v1/salesos/practices, GET /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/kit, POST /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/brief, POST /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/script, and add a SalesOS stack view to lifeos-app.html.

steps.name: Acceptance test
steps.acceptance: End-to-end run against production: research a real or fixture therapist URL, generate kit, brief, CRM record, and script.

non_goals: No live call recording or transcription in Phase 1
No automated outbound dial/SMS without explicit consent
No replacement for Outreach CRM or BoldTrail as CRM of record
open_decisions: CRM table strategy (reuse crm_contacts vs side table)
